name: Capital Requirement 1
definition: Report of the breakdown of the components for the capital requirement for central counterparty.

WindingDownOrRestructuringRisk.name: Winding Down Or Restructuring Risk
WindingDownOrRestructuringRisk.definition: Indicates the capital necessary to cover the winding down or restructuring of activities.

OperationalAndLegalRisk.name: Operational And Legal Risk
OperationalAndLegalRisk.definition: Indicates the capital necessary to cover the overall operational and legal risks.

CreditRisk.name: Credit Risk
CreditRisk.definition: Indicates the capital necessary to cover credit risks not already covered by other financial resources, such as risks stemming from clearing activity.

CounterPartyRisk.name: Counter Party Risk
CounterPartyRisk.definition: Indicates the capital necessary to cover counterparty credit risks not already covered by other financial resources, such as risks stemming from clearing activity.

MarketRisk.name: Market Risk
MarketRisk.definition: Indicates the capital necessary to cover counterparty market risks not already covered by other financial resources, such as risks stemming from clearing activity.

BusinessRisk.name: Business Risk
BusinessRisk.definition: Indicates the capital necessary to cover business risk.

NotificationBuffer.name: Notification Buffer
NotificationBuffer.definition: Indicates the percentage above 100 percent of the CCP’s required capital requiring notification to the CCP’s National Competent Authority threshold.
